Known for warpstone narcotics and a remarkable number of horned young, the clan feeds both its appetites and its ambitions through crowded breeding pits and illicit trade. Kidnapping gangs supply labor and victims, while struggles over drugs and privilege spill from the warrens into the streets above.

name: Clan Sleekit
placement: Fielbach, on the navigable Reik south of Altdorf; represents riverside tunnel entrances outside the capital.
description: River transporters with their own vessels and workshops can blockade underground commerce and raid surface docks.
basis: Lore adaptation — [Clan Sleekit](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/Clan_Sleekit).
flag_brief: A white rat triangle mounted on a black keel above three silver waves on dark teal
enclave_description: Fleetmaster Shipgnawer Nikkitt's Clan Sleekit controls hidden docks beneath Fielbach, linked to the river traffic of Under-Altdorf. Its barges carry Skaven goods, warriors, and contraband through channels the surface authorities scarcely understand. Dockside theft and sudden interruptions to trade reveal only fragments of the network, while armed crews ensure that those who discover its landings seldom return to report them.

name: Clan Septik
placement: Dotternbach, between Nuln and Wissenburg; a surface foothold for the proposed Wissenland plague enclave.
description: A Pestilent Brotherhood clan spreads disease and challenges rival plague authorities for control of regional infections.
basis: Lore adaptation — [Clan Septik](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/Clan_Septik); a permanent Wissenland base is proposed.
flag_brief: A pale rat skull with three green hanging drops inside a jagged ochre triangle on dark brown
enclave_description: Blightskab's Clan Septik Plaguepack shelters beneath Dotternbach. Fanatical servants of Pestilens, its warriors wrap diseased bodies in filthy bandages and carry corroded weapons into the tunnels around their refuge. They spread infection through stolen supplies and contaminated passages, weakening the settlements above before emerging to harvest captives and claim the stricken ground.

name: Clan Kreepus
placement: Eaglecrest, in western Cathay; a surface foothold for a concealed tunnel junction.
description: An Eshin thrall becomes a border intelligence enclave, attacking human officials and competing for assassination contracts.
basis: Lore adaptation — [clan list](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/List_of_Skaven_clans); the eastern base and political role are invented.
flag_brief: A silver assassin knife with a green rat eye in its hilt inside a crooked triangle on near-black purple
enclave_description: Garrott of Mordheim leads Clan Kreepus from a concealed warren in Eaglecrest. Once enslaved by a rival clan, the Kreepus rats won freedom with poisoned daggers supplied by Eshin, wielding them with their tails when shackles bound their paws. Their debt became willing service, and the clan now turns that murderous skill against officials, rivals, and patrols that threaten its refuge.

name: Clan Feesik
placement: Mangrove Delta, in the eastern Southlands; proposed plague monastery beneath the delta.
description: A Pestilent Brotherhood enclave could specialize in infected irrigation and demand tribute from nearby burrows.
basis: Lore adaptation — [clan list](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/List_of_Skaven_clans); the location and irrigation specialty are invented.
flag_brief: A black rat triangle over an ivory swollen plague bell on sickly mustard green
enclave_description: Rikzik Seepage's Clan Feesik festers beneath the Mangrove Delta. Poverty and filth have made the clan a fitting client for Pestilens, though its professions of devotion conceal the same struggle for survival that drives any lesser Skaven power. Fouled irrigation channels spread sickness through the fields above, while stolen harvests and captive labor keep Seepage's hungry warrens alive.

name: Clan Gratzz
placement: Xotec, beside Oxyl in southern Lustria; proposed temple undercroft outside the capital.
description: A minor plague clan could raid spawning pools while resisting demands from stronger Pestilens governors.
basis: Lore adaptation — [clan list](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/List_of_Skaven_clans); the location and independence struggle are invented.
flag_brief: A bone rat claw holding three dripping green teeth over a red plague circle on dark olive
enclave_description: Gratzik Rotwhisker's Clan Gratzz occupies plague warrens below Xotec. Bound to the Pestilent Brotherhood but resentful of its greater masters, the clan seeks captives and sacred spoils with which to improve its standing. Raids on spawning pools and temple supplies spread disease through the surrounding jungle, while Rotwhisker hides the best of the plunder from those who demand his obedience.

name: Clan Rikket
placement: Ratscar, the coastal Skryre foothold beside the Blighted Marshes and an existing entrance to the Under-Empire.
description: A naval clan offers an underground shipbuilding power, fighting over exits to the sea and captive labor.
basis: Lore adaptation — [Skaven Clanfleet](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/Skaven_Clanfleet); shipyard placement proposed.
flag_brief: An ivory rat triangle enclosing a rusty gear and green spark on black ochre
enclave_description: Rikkaz Warpwake's Clan Rikket shelters its vessels in the hidden shipyards of Ratscar. One of the Skaven's seafaring clans, it contests the trade and raiding grounds claimed by Skurvy and Skuttle. Captives labor beneath tar-stained timbers, stolen cargo fills the caves, and new hulls take shape for voyages that threaten both coastal settlements and rival rat fleets.

name: Clan Skuttle
placement: Dusklair, in the Tilean Sea's Thousand Isles; proposed flooded-cavern shipyard taken from Skurvy's island network.
description: Another naval clan gives Rikket and existing Skurvy a rival; emphasize boarding raids and stolen hulls for differentiation.
basis: Lore adaptation — [Skaven Clanfleet](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/Skaven_Clanfleet). Also spelled Skuttel; the base and specialization are proposed.
flag_brief: A white rat claw gripping a shattered gold key above a crooked tunnel arch on dark slate blue
enclave_description: Skuttik Bilgetail's Clan Skuttle keeps an armed anchorage in Dusklair. The clan commands one of the largest Skaven fleets, second only to Skurvy, and its crews prize ships that can be captured intact and pressed into service. Boarding raids feed the harbor with stolen hulls, cargo, and labor, while rivalry with other clans keeps its guards as watchful inland as at sea.

name: Clan Gristlecrack
placement: Snikt, a cavern below the southern Worlds Edge Mountains.
description: A minor clan could build its power around surgical workshops and captive auctions, attacking both Dwarf holds and rival suppliers.
basis: Lore adaptation — [clan list](https://whfb.lexicanum.com/wiki/List_of_Skaven_clans). Only the name is sourced; location, Moulder affinity, and surgical specialization are invented.
flag_brief: A bone rat skull stitched with black lines above two hooked red cleavers on dirty gray
enclave_description: Grissk Fleshsuture's Clan Gristlecrack operates hidden flesh-workshops beneath Snikt. The enclave's handlers trade captives and malformed beasts to Moulder buyers, testing their own crude surgery on whatever the raiding gangs drag below. Escaped specimens prowl the outer tunnels, while slave auctions and stolen livestock keep the workshops supplied with bodies that living settlements can ill afford to lose.
